items.title: Between alerts: What Attackers Do in the Spaces Ordinary Detection Misses
items.snippet: Every SOC struggles with a pile of alerts. Very few of those alerts explain how an attack started or how it progressed. Network data, like that from a network detection and response (NDR) platform, connects individual alerts into one timeline, and it feeds the defensive systems that can tie all events together into one
items.summary: The article says network data from NDR can connect individual alerts into a timeline, helping show how an attack started and progressed.
items.why: Use network data to correlate alerts and build a clearer incident timeline.

items.title: uCreator Android Spyware Can Steal Telegram 2FA Passwords and Clone WeChat Accounts
items.snippet: A rentable Android spyware kit called uCreator takes over Telegram and WeChat accounts by hiding its code inside working copies of the two apps, researcher Ovi found. It only reaches people who install one of these tampered copies, spread outside the official app stores, or who run WeChat inside the kit makers' own con
items.summary: Researcher Ovi found uCreator spyware hides in tampered Telegram and WeChat copies to take over accounts. It reaches people who install copies spread outside official channels.
items.why: Warn users to install messaging apps through official channels and check for tampered copies.

analysis.headline: Exposure, Operations and Strategic Signals
paragraphs: Several stories describe systems or infrastructure whose effects extend beyond a single component: LiteLLM says an exposed key enabled a supply-chain attack, while PHP2Shell exploitation moved to working shells. The Wasmtime report likewise describes flaws that could cross a sandbox boundary.

For defenders, these reports suggest checking credentials, software exposure and containment, while correlating alerts into timelines. The online-store loader story adds another reason to examine what code serves visitors. These are distinct cases, but each makes visibility into dependencies and execution relevant.

Elsewhere, Astranis describes a dedicated Falcon 9 mission for its satellite production run, and Naval News reports a planned missile facility. The top stories also include a new Turkish unmanned aircraft and West Bank expulsions. Analysts can watch how deployments and infrastructure plans develop, alongside reported changes on the ground.
takeaways: Review exposed keys, affected software and containment boundaries.
Correlate alerts and inspect code that serves users.
Track launch plans, military systems and reported changes on the ground.
